description: Find companies by what they do, not by name: a curated topic ('software', 'retail'), plain words ('dentists', a CAEN class title; see matched) or CAEN codes ('4321,4322'; 6201 also finds Rev.3 6210). Narrow by county; qualify by revenue, headcount, VAT, main activity. active_only (default) drops dead and ANAF-inactive firms.

active_only.description: Default true: drop firms that are not a lead (struck off, dissolving, in liquidation, insolvent or bankrupt, activity suspended, or ANAF fiscally inactive). false returns every firm.
active_only.title: Active Only

compact.description: Optional: true keeps a short preset per row (name, CUI, county, city, legal form, risk level, phone, website, latest revenue and headcount).
compact.title: Compact

county.description: Optional county name to narrow to (diacritic-insensitive: 'bucuresti', 'cluj'); omit for nationwide.
county.title: County

fields.description: Optional: keep only these company fields in each row, comma-separated (companyName,cui,county,risk; dotted paths such as risk.level work). Without it the full record is returned.
fields.title: Fields

has_website.description: true keeps only firms with a website on file in the registry (default false).
has_website.title: Has Website

legal_form.description: Optional legal form(s) to keep, comma-separated, case-insensitive: 'SRL', 'SA', 'PFA', 'II', or 'SRL,SA' (companies, no sole traders). Default: any form.
legal_form.title: Legal Form

main_activity_only.description: true keeps firms whose declared main activity (ANAF main CAEN, else the CAEN on the latest filing) is one of the codes, instead of any authorised activity (default false).
main_activity_only.title: Main Activity Only

max_employees.description: Optional maximum average headcount on the latest filing.
max_employees.title: Max Employees

max_results.description: Maximum number of companies to return (1-100, default 10).
max_results.title: Max Results

max_revenue.description: Optional maximum net turnover in RON on the latest filing.
max_revenue.title: Max Revenue

min_employees.description: Optional minimum average headcount on the latest filing.
min_employees.title: Min Employees

min_revenue.description: Optional minimum net turnover in RON on the latest filing (FY2025, else FY2024). Firms without a filing never match a band.
min_revenue.title: Min Revenue

topic.description: What the firms do: a curated topic ('software', 'retail'), plain words for a trade ('dentists', 'stomatologie'), a CAEN class title in Romanian or English, or CAEN codes ('6201' or '4321,4322'). Case-, space- and diacritic-insensitive. A number that names another activity in each revision takes a suffix: '4781r3' (Rev.3) or '4781r2' (Rev.2).
topic.title: Topic

vat_payer.description: Optional: true keeps VAT-registered firms only, false only non-VAT payers (ANAF data). Omit for both.
vat_payer.title: Vat Payer

name: lookup_by_category

outputSchema.description: A lead list: firms in an activity, newest registration first.

asOf.description: What to cite: registry (ONRC snapshot date), financialYear (fiscal year of the figures), anaf (day of the ANAF data), snapshot, published, source.

attribution.description: The credit line to keep when redistributing the data (CC BY 4.0).

availableTopics.description: The curated topics, when the topic is unknown.

caenCodes.description: The CAEN codes searched, when given or derived as codes.

candidates.description: When the words fit several activities (ambiguous_topic): the ones to choose from.

codesAdded.description: CAEN Rev.2/Rev.3 counterparts added to the search.

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

fields.description: The company fields kept when fields or compact trimmed the rows.

filters.description: The filters applied (legalForm, activeOnly, revenue and headcount bands, vatPayer, mainActivityOnly ...).

inactiveFilteredOut.description: Firms removed by active_only (null when off).

inactiveFilteredOutApproximate.description: true when that count is estimated.

label.description: Human label of what was matched.

matched.description: How plain words were read: by, niche or class title, codes.

items.description: A company record: companyName, cui, registrationCode, registrationDate (DD/MM/YYYY), legalForm, euid, address, county, city, website, phone, caenActivities [{code, activity}], directors, status [{code, name}], latestFinancials {year, revenue, netResult, employees; RON}, anaf {mainCaen, vatPayer, eFactura, inactive}, risk {level, label, reasons, isLead}, source, asOf, and score/match on name searches. With fields or compact, only the requested keys.

source.description: Data source: onrc (registry) or mfp (Ministry of Finance filings).

topic.description: The curated topic matched, if any.

truncated.description: true when more firms match than were returned.

warnings.description: Notes on how the request was read (a clamped limit, a widened CAEN code, an ignored field).

title: Find companies by activity
